# Victorian Government (vic.gov.au)

> Victoria's official government portal providing access to public services, emergency information, education, health, employment, and community resources.

vic.gov.au serves as the primary digital gateway for Victorian residents and visitors to access government services, information, and tools. The site integrates multiple service platforms including Service Victoria, VicEmergency, and Better Health Channel to deliver comprehensive public information across education, health, transportation, employment, and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- Victorian Government
- Service Victoria
- Public services
- Education and training
- Health services
- Emergency response
- Employment and jobs
- TAFE and apprenticeships
- Transportation
- Community resources
- Arts and culture
- Background checks
- Accessibility services
- Government structure
- Savings and rebates

## Government Services & Portal

- [Find, connect, shape your Victorian Government](https://www.vic.gov.au): Victorian Government portal offering grants, services, and community engagement tools.
- [About the Victorian Government](https://www.vic.gov.au/about-victorian-government): Overview of Victorian Government structure, departments, and policies.
- [The Premier and ministers](https://www.vic.gov.au/premier-and-ministers): Information on Victorian Premier, ministers, and Cabinet members.
- [Contact us](https://www.vic.gov.au/contact-us): Victorian Government contact information and accessibility services.

## Emergency & Safety

- [Incidents and Warnings - VicEmergency](https://www.emergency.vic.gov.au/respond): Real-time emergency alerts and incident tracking for Victoria.
- [Working with Children Check](https://www.vic.gov.au/working-with-children-check): Screening process guide for people working with children in Victoria.
- [NDIS Worker Screening Check](https://www.vic.gov.au/ndis-worker-screening-check): NDIS worker background check application and eligibility information.

## Education & Training

- [Free TAFE makes it real](https://www.vic.gov.au/free-tafe): Free TAFE vocational training program information and course details.
- [Thinking about training?](https://www.vic.gov.au/thinking-about-training): Guide to training options including TAFE, apprenticeships, and career pathways.
- [School term dates and holidays in Victoria](https://www.vic.gov.au/school-term-dates-and-holidays-victoria): Victorian school term dates, holidays, and exam schedules through 2030.
- [School Jobs Vic](https://www.vic.gov.au/school-jobs): Victorian government school recruitment system for teacher and support roles.

## Employment & Careers

- [Jobs and careers](https://www.vic.gov.au/jobs-and-careers): Employment resources, apprenticeships, and workplace rights information.

## Health & Wellbeing

- [Urgent Care Services Victoria](https://www.betterhealth.vic.gov.au/urgent-care-services): Guide to urgent care services, clinics, and 24/7 healthcare options.

## Transport & Savings

- [Using the Metro Tunnel - Victoria's Big Build](https://bigbuild.vic.gov.au/use-metro-tunnel/home): Metro Tunnel user guide with timetables, stations, and accessibility info.
- [Servo Saver](https://service.vic.gov.au/find-services/transport-and-driving/servo-saver): Live fuel price comparison tool for Victoria with Service Victoria app.
- [What is the Savings Finder?](https://www.vic.gov.au/savingsfinder): Tool to find government rebates and eligibility for energy and transport savings.

## Arts, Culture & Community

- [Arts, culture and heritage](https://www.vic.gov.au/arts-culture-and-heritage): Guide to Victoria's arts, museums, galleries, libraries and cultural institutions.
- [Sport and recreation](https://www.vic.gov.au/sport-and-recreation): Information on Victoria's sporting facilities, parks, and outdoor recreation.

## Optional

- [Crime Moves Around. So Do We.](https://www.vic.gov.au/crime-moves-around-and-now-so-do-we): Operation Pulse update on Victoria Police patrols in shopping centres.
